[[File:Life_Day_incense_burner.jpg|thumb|250px|A Wookiee Life Day incense burner]]
'''Incense burners''' were containers of varied size and shape, which were used to burn fragrant substances known as [[Incense/Legends|incenses]]. The [[Darth Sidious' Sith Chalice/Legends|Sith Chalice]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was an incense burner<ref name="FF13 2014">{{FactFile2014|13|COR 13-14|Palpatine's Private Offices}}</ref> filled with [[Korribanian incense]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]''</ref> During the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] made use of incense burners.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
